officialResultExports.notes: County President and Attorney General rows are available in the certified statewide canvass PDF text layer. No statewide precinct/local reporting-unit export was collected in this pass.

turnoutRegistration.notes: The G24 sheet provides county total ballots counted and Active voters. EAC fallback rows remain retained as a benchmark but are no longer the active UT turnout source.

historicalBaselines.notes: The Utah historical-results page links official 2020 and 2016 Excel/PDF artifacts and 2012 General Election source pages. A future pass should normalize those official artifacts to replace the secondary baseline.

precinctGeometry.notes: County geometry is loaded for map joins. No official statewide precinct boundary geometry or county-to-precinct crosswalk is loaded.

auditCvrIncidentsCorrectionsLitigation.notes: The 2024 Election Information page links a CD2 recount report and county canvass certification paths. No normalized Utah post-election audit, CVR availability, incident, correction, litigation, L&A, tabulator-log, or custody rows are loaded.

equipmentContext.caveat: Verified Voting equipment context is supplemental jurisdiction metadata only.
